title: Nonvanishing or Uniruledness for Smooth Projective Varieties
exact_target: Does every smooth projective variety $X$ either have a nonzero pluricanonical section in $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(mK_X))$ for some $m>0$, or is it covered by rational curves?
